objective: Declare, before any run, how the independent data verifier draws random samples from already-gathered backtester output and what it re-checks against that same artefact. This file declares sampling policy and tolerances only. It contains no results, no accuracy claim and no edge claim.
independence_rule: The verifier re-derives each checked value from the artefact itself: arithmetic identities, ledger partitions, price-to-outcome recomputation and payload hashes. It never trusts a stored summary, never re-runs the evaluation, and never writes to the ledger, a capture lane, a registry or the sealed prospective window.

sampling.reproducibility: The same seed, sample size and source ordering reproduce the same sampled units. Every sampled unit key is written into the report, so any finding can be replayed by hand.

checks: every compared field present on both sides is equal
every nested block present on both sides is equal
every difference entry and factor comparison carries a PASS status
net edge equals bull case minus bear case
participation equals active directional weight
active directional weight equals bull plus bear weighted totals
case split is 100 or explicitly absent
the stored evaluation label reproduces from the recorded open/close prices and flat threshold
the declared row summary reconciles with a whole-file recount
direction counts sum to the record n
magnitude observations equal the record n
n never exceeds matched anchors
the four exclusion reasons partition every attempt
endpoint denominators sum to all computed
year breakdown sums to the record n and each year's directions sum to that year's n
eligibility min_n is the declared value and matches the reported or ineligible status
whole-file census reconciles with the accepted 28-factor census

targets.unit: variable, cohort, horizon, group and state cell
checks: direction counts sum to the cell n
magnitude observations equal the cell n
a year breakdown never sums to more than its own cell n
each year's directions sum to that year's n
small_sample flag matches the declared minimum observations

targets.unit: sealed capture envelope with its index entry
checks: the decoded payload hash equals the declared raw hash
the index payload hash equals the envelope metadata raw hash
the envelope file hash equals the index envelope hash
index metadata and bindings match the envelope metadata and bindings
the envelope state is complete_sealed
the payload observation count matches the declared observation count when the payload exposes one
targets.fixture_rule: Envelopes whose metadata declares synthetic true are the drift and recovery fixtures that exist to prove the collectors detect tampering. Their value disagreements are counted and reported as injected fixture behaviour, and never reported as live faults. Envelopes with synthetic false are real captures and every disagreement is a fault.

fixture_lane_note: These path fragments identify the collector test lanes that exist to prove drift, recovery and sealing detection, including lanes whose stored index hash is intentionally stale. They are classified as fixtures so their injected disagreements are reported as fixture behaviour rather than live faults. Declare an empty list (or pass --fixture-pattern '') to judge those lanes as faults as well; envelopes whose metadata declares synthetic true are always treated as fixtures.
limits: Independent re-checking of recorded output only. The verifier cannot confirm anything the sources never recorded, and it cannot confirm that a provider sent what the envelope claims.
Random sampling bounds effort, not error. A clean sample is consistent with, not proof of, a clean population; sample sizes and the seed are declared so the covered units are known.
No measurement is added, no new data is gathered, no Layer 1 logic is touched and the sealed prospective window is not read.
A passing verification run is not evidence of predictive accuracy, timing, profitability or trading edge.
